Backup and local data

Build revisions remain in the builder’s existing storage. This workspace stores notes, journal entries, manual quotes, purchase and warranty records, saved comparisons and watched part IDs locally. Clearing browser data removes these local records. Use the same browser and device to return to your work.

Workspace exports contain private notes, purchase records and any warranty references. Keep the file somewhere safe. Builder links contain parts and plan choices, never these notes or journal entries.
